elements.element: Cap limb (a): fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim" — 'all amounts' is not the fee basis and the anchor is an event, not the claim

elements.element: Cap is the greater of the two limbs and mutual
elements.evidence: "the greater of (a) ... and (b) USD 1,000,000. The cap is mutual"
No exclusion of indirect or consequential damages appears in 21.1 or the supplied text; only "total aggregate liability ... shall not exceed"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for breach of confidentiality, data protection and security obligations
elements.evidence: "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of confidentiality, data-protection, or security obligations" and 21.1 "Except for Excluded Claims"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud
Uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: "infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's intellectual property"

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not 'damages' for cap purposes
elements.evidence: "Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees for conforming Services is not damages" — limited to undisputed 'Fees' (the USD 12,000 Implementation Fee) for conforming Services, not payment obligations generally

elements.element: Fallback: mutual cap of 12 months' fees
elements.evidence: Cap is "the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable ... and (b) USD 1,000,000" — not a 12 months' fees cap, and it imports the preferred-only USD 1,000,000 amount

elements.element: Fallback carve-outs: indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: "breach of confidentiality ... its indemnification obligations; gross negligence, wilful misconduct"

reasons: Preferred is incomplete: the fee limb was rewritten as 'all amounts paid or payable' anchored to 'the event giving rise to the claim' rather than the required 'fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim'.
No mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages is present in the operative text, so that preferred element is unmet.

The payment-obligations element is unmet: the existing sentence is confined to 'undisputed Fees for conforming Services', which under the defined 'Fees' is only the USD 12,000 Implementation Fee; it should read that Customer's payment obligations (or amounts due) are not damages and are not limited by this Section.
Carve-outs fully satisfy both levels via the Excluded Claims definition (confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP).
Fallback is not independently satisfied because the drafted cap is a greater-of construct using the preferred-only USD 1,000,000 figure and an 'all amounts' basis rather than 12 months' fees.
Edit is narrow (single sentence operator/basis change) and introduces no undefined terms or dangling mechanics, so minimality and intent preservation hold.
